FROM THE SHELTON FAMILY ARCHIVE

A family trade, carried forward.

  1. c. 1898

    White Star Laundry Begins

    In Oklahoma, Grandpa and Grandma Shelton joined Gertie, Elma, Mary, John Shelton, Sr., Mason Shelton, and others to open White Star Laundry. What began as a shared family undertaking established a trade in cleaning, finishing, dependable service, and customer care that the Shelton family would carry forward for four generations.

  2. 1930s

    Unit Laundry Takes Root in Tucson

    By the 1930s, Unit Laundry had become the family’s next major chapter in Tucson. The building and route vehicles reflect a growing operation, while the daily work remained grounded in careful processing, reliable pickup and return, and goods finished for immediate use.

  3. 1950s

    The Family Reaches San Diego

    Unit Cleaners marked the family’s first presence in San Diego. The family built the facility and completed the equipment installation and operational setup themselves, bringing generations of practical knowledge into a new market.

  4. 1960s

    State Street Operations Grow

    The State Street assembly area shows the organization required to return finished garments accurately and efficiently. As the operation grew, new generations carried the trade forward while adapting to changing equipment, greater volume, and rising customer expectations.

  5. 1981

    Imperial Cleaners Opens

    Imperial Cleaners opened in Long Beach as the family’s network continued to grow across Southern California. By this point, the Shelton name had become increasingly established in professional dry cleaning through neighborhood locations built around dependable care, convenience, and service.

  6. 2003

    Modern Plant Operations

    The Sterling Cleaners facility illustrates the infrastructure behind a modern cleaning plant. Reliable equipment, heat, pressure, maintenance, and disciplined workflows supported the visible service customers experienced and the quality delivered with every completed order.

  7. 2019

    Shelton Cleaners Opens

    Shelton Cleaners opened in San Diego as the retail home for the family’s next chapter. The operation connected decades of cleaning experience with modern garment care, responsive customer service, and the trust developed through direct relationships with the community.

  8. 2023

    Wholesale Department Launches

    Shelton expanded into wholesale service to support commercial partners with greater volume and more specialized needs. This new department brought the family’s experience in cleaning and finishing into programs designed around dependable production, clear communication, and consistent service.

  9. 2026

    Shelton Linen & Uniform Services

    Shelton Linen & Uniform Services carries four generations of family experience into a dedicated commercial operation. The company combines modern equipment, organized route service, practical innovation, and attentive customer support to serve businesses throughout the San Diego region.
